item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker

turns.text: Make this wide photo square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else.

item.tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The entire white sneaker, including the toe and heel.
answer_sheet.Style, text and other edits: Keep the original photo appearance. No added text or other edits.

must_haves: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.

turns.text: I'd like to get this wide photo ready to share. I've been second-guessing how it will look once I post it. What I need is to make this pic square for an Instagram post. Please keep the whole sneaker in view, without stretching it. Other than making it square, don't change anything else.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the square version. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was created and no credits were used.

**Why it can't just be cropped:** the sneaker takes up about 80% of the photo's width. Cutting the sides down to a square would cut off the heel or the toe. To keep the whole shoe at its real proportions, the picture has to be made taller instead, with more floor added below and more wall above.

**How to get it done:**
- **Add credits on Magic Hour.** I tried the cheapest free-plan image editor, which costs about 5 credits for one image. Once you have the credits, tell me and I'll run it again. It will add matching floor and background above and below the photo and leave the shoe and the rest of the picture as they are.
- **Do it yourself for free.** In Instagram's crop screen, tap the expand icon to fit the whole photo. Instagram then adds white bars above and below. Most phone editors and free apps like Canva or "No Crop" can add bars too. This keeps everything in the photo exactly as it is, sneaker included, with no AI changes. Bars in white or light grey would match the shoe and the floor well.

Since you wanted nothing else changed, the bars option is the safest. It's also free and you can do it now.
